answer: Each new agent locks 50,000 POA in a reputation escrow before it can attest or be attested. Voting weight is escrowed tokens times account age, so a one-epoch clone votes like a trickle beside a forty-epoch account's tide. When a jury proves an attested identity was sybil, escrow slashes thirty percent from every peer who vouched, and the slashed POA burns. Forging ten thousand fakes locks 500 million POA for forty epochs, capital one attacker rarely holds. A plume of fake attestations dies at the ledge of real escrowed history.
